views.label: Standalone assets
views.subtitle: What financial institutions hold on their own balance sheets.
views.blurb: Standalone assets for a company do not incorporate assets of subsidiaries. Official German statistics use standalone figures. Compare these aggregates with official totals of €9.5tn for banks, €2.3tn for insurers and €0.8tn for pension institutions (BaFin, ABV, Bundesbank).

views.label: Consolidated assets
views.subtitle: What corporate groups hold, counting each subsidiary once inside its parent.
views.blurb: Consolidated assets for a company include those of every subsidiary. Assets of subsidiaries that lie outside of Germany are colored gray. Compare these figures to ECB official totals of €7.6tn for German-owned banking groups and €1.4tn for foreign-owned banks in Germany.

views.label: Consolidated assets under management
views.subtitle: What asset managers manage (on others' balance sheets), grouped by who owns them.
views.blurb: Consolidated AUM for a company includes AUM of every subsidiary. AUM of subsidiaries that lie outside of Germany are colored gray. Compare these figures with official totals of €3.1tn in funds domiciled in Germany (Bundesbank) and a 2024 assessment of Allianz at €2.45tn (TAI).
